data.name: [UPD] Win A World Championship
data.description:
Build your dream football nation and win the ultimate World Championship!

-Play with ALL Nations and Years
-Spin Cards and pick the best players
-Open packs and upgrade your squad
-Create the strongest team and become champion
-Compete, collect, improve, and dominate every tournament!

CODES: 
WORLDHUNT
MANAGERS
VISIT10M 
LIKES10K
MEMBERS200K 
INDEX 

Can you build the greatest national team of all time?

Console toggle between moving and selecting is done with the button "SELECT".
